race.comment: PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL (4) nice colt, undefeated in two starts. Sat off the speed in the small field and rounded them up with ease in fast time over 1150m at Illawarra Grange. Will handle the extra trip and class rise with Lloyd retaining the ride. BLITZGAL (5) resumed with an eye catching fifth over 1100m at Canterbury in F&M BM72 class. J Mac hops aboard and will relish the extra ground. RUMDABAR (9) exciting colt resuming. Won his Maiden in good style two back at Newcastle, then came to the end of his prep when fifth over 1400m at Randwick on the heavy track last July. Fitted with the two trials and stays in the mix. SPHERE (11) deep into the prep and gets the gun run again. Hung out throughout with a below par fifth over this track and trip. Claim helps and look for a better performance.
